newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton steady in selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton steady in selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Wednesday for the second successive session as spinners kept to sidelines while exporters bought selectively, dealers said.
They said spinners were still making up their minds whether to import raw cotton or buy from the local market after the government announced a cut import duties earlier in the week.
But selective buying from exporters helped ginners resist any pressure to cut deals at lower levels, one dealer said.
